components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9() ]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when
            provided it must be unique across all owners.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's initials from the first letters of the first
                and last name, upper-cased and dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            registrationDate:
              title: Registration date
              description: The date the owner was registered, defaulting to the
                current date when not supplied. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
              type: string
              format: date
              example: '2013-01-01'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The sequential membership number assigned when the owner
                is created, equal to one more than the number of owners that existed
                at the time of creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 11
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The customer code assigned when the owner is created,
                formatted as '<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>' where NNNN is one more than
                the number of owners that already existed in that city at the time
                of creation, zero-padded to four digits.
              type: string
              example: 'LONDON-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The membership tier assigned when the owner is created.

              type: string

I implemented the `locality` field on owner creation, following the existing "assign derived field" pattern used by sibling steps like `AssignNamesakeCount` and `AssignSharesHousehold`.

**Changes:**

1. **`AssignLocality.java`** (new) — A pipeline function that, before the owner is saved, tallies the cities of all existing owners (`OwnerRepository.findAll()`), finds the top count, and sets `locality` to `"local"` only when the owner's city is the *strictly* single most common existing city (no other city ties the top count); otherwise `"remote"`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — Added the `@Transient String locality` field with getter/setter, matching how the other computed fields (`namesakeCount`, `sharesHousehold`, etc.) are held in-memory and returned through the same-transaction GET.

4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — Wired `assignLocality` into the creation pipeline after `assignSharesHousehold` and before `save`, so it computes against existing owners only (excluding the one being created).

**Semantics note:** "the *single* most common city" is treated strictly — if two or more cities tie for the highest count, no city is the single most common, so the result is `"remote"`.
